case_title: HARRIS LYDELL E et al VS JEFERSON HENRY M OWNER DBA JJ S SUPER AUTO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY HARRIS LYDELL E HARRIS CHERYL AS TO DEFENDANT JEFERSON HENRY M OWNER DBA JJ S SUPER AUTO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-29-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT JEFERSON HENRY M OWNER DBA JJ S SUPER AUTO

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HARRIS LYDELL E HARRIS CHERYL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT JEFERSON HENRY M OWNER DBA JJ S SUPER AUTO DEFENDATS SHOULD RELEASE THE AUTO TO PLTF UPON PLTF PYTMT OF $2500 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING AMENDED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HARRIS LYDELL E HARRIS CHERYL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT JEFERSON HENRY M OWNER DBA JJ S SUPER AUTO $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,000.00, IN THE EVENT DEFENDANT RELEASED THE AUTO IN RE- PAIRED CONDITION PLAINTIFF'S UPON PLAINTIFF'S STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
